name: Quick-Insight
author: Ahsan Riad

sections.description:
Quick-Insight is a handy WordPress plugin designed to give you a quick overview of your site’s key information. It displays the active theme name, the total number of posts and published pages, and a detailed look at storage usage, highlighting both free and used space. The plugin uses the REST API and React to fetch and display storage information using interactive graphs for a visually engaging experience.

When activated, Quick-Insight immediately presents a dashboard with all the key site insights, making it easy to access important details right from the start.

Key Features:
– Display the active theme name
– Show the total number of posts
– List the total number of published pages
– Provide detailed storage information (free and used space) using React-powered graphs
– Uses the WordPress REST API for efficient data handling
– Automatically show the Quick-Insight dashboard on activation
– Simple and intuitive interface for easy access to site information

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/Quick-Insight directory or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Upon activation, the Quick-Insight dashboard will be displayed, showing your site’s key information, including interactive storage graphs.
sections.faq:
What information does Quick-Insight provide?

Quick-Insight shows the active theme name, the total number of posts, the total number of published pages, and storage information, including free and used space visualized using React graphs.

Does Quick-Insight use REST API and React?

Yes, Quick-Insight uses the WordPress REST API to fetch data and React to display storage information in an interactive and user-friendly manner.

Is there any impact on performance?

No, Quick-Insight is designed to be lightweight and uses efficient data handling through the REST API and React, ensuring no significant impact on site performance.

How often is the storage information updated?

Storage information is fetched and updated every time you refresh the Quick-Insight page in the WordPress dashboard.
